raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00), so its 334 rows appear as exact duplicate pairs. The raw txn_id range is contiguous and unique (4866 distinct ids), so all duplicates come from that re-delivery, and silver_transactions has no dedup step. Deduplicating by txn_id fixes silver and all the gold tables built from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
